scope: Actual Acupoints and Hydration inline scripts under synthetic localStorage and a minimal DOM
checks: Acupoints refuses restoration after a reviewed deletion
Acupoints preserves a newer external record and current selection
Acupoints updates its snapshot after own saves and supports removal without an element
Acupoints failed write preserves selection and can retry
Acupoints read failure before write cannot overwrite
Acupoints malformed, empty and non-array stores are preserved
Acupoints fresh empty storage can save
Hydration refuses restoration after deletion and retains custom input
Hydration preserves newer external bytes on Add, Undo and weight change
Hydration successful writes advance snapshot and preserve extra fields
Hydration failed write keeps old log/input and retry adds only once
Hydration read failure before save preserves original bytes
Hydration malformed or unsupported stored data is never replaced
Hydration fresh empty storage can save
limitations: Not a browser/native layout test or a transaction guarantee across simultaneous localStorage writers.
